Tranquil evening or not, we appreciate your message and we are treating this as a serious service failure. You said your companion animal's crate was mishandled, your travel experience was disrupted, and the response you received did not reflect the care Aurelia Skyways promises. We understand how upsetting that is, especially when a pet's safety, comfort, and trust are involved.

Companion Animal Travel Desk: <<FACT F118>> We are placing this matter into urgent review and asking the handling team to preserve all records tied to the crate, the transfer path, and the arrival inspection. If any item was separated from the shipment or if the crate was delayed, we will make sure the report is assessed through the proper claim channel and that the next steps are clear.

We also want to address the service lapse itself. When a traveler reaches out about a companion animal, the reply must be prompt, respectful, and specific. If the communication you received felt dismissive or incomplete, that is not the standard we expect from Aurelia Skyways. We are flagging this for a stepwise review so the handling, the airport coordination, and the customer response are checked together rather than in isolation. That approach helps us find the break in service and prevents the issue from being minimized.

If you are still waiting for follow-up, we recommend keeping all shipping tags, photos, and written notes from the journey in one place so the review can move without delay. We will not ask you to repeat your concern more than necessary, and we will push for a direct update once the records have been examined. If the crate or its contents were affected, your report deserves immediate attention and a careful resolution.

Thank you for bringing this to us. We are sorry for the distress this caused and we will continue to advocate for a fair review until the case is fully addressed.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
